content: You are an expert in reinforcement learning reward design. You will be shown several candidate reward functions for the same task. Each will be used, unchanged, to train a PPO policy for 3000 iterations with identical hyperparameters. Predict which rewards will produce the best task performance, where task performance is measured by the environment's own forward-progress metric, not by the candidate reward itself.

Task: to make the ant run forward as fast as possible.

Environment code:
class Ant(VecTask):
    """Rest of the environment definition omitted."""
    def compute_observations(self):
        self.gym.refresh_dof_state_tensor(self.sim)
        self.gym.refresh_actor_root_state_tensor(self.sim)
        self.gym.refresh_force_sensor_tensor(self.sim)

        self.obs_buf[:], self.potentials[:], self.prev_potentials[:], self.up_vec[:], self.heading_vec[:] = compute_ant_observations(
            self.obs_buf, self.root_states, self.targets, self.potentials,
            self.inv_start_rot, self.dof_pos, self.dof_vel,
            self.dof_limits_lower, self.dof_limits_upper, self.dof_vel_scale,
            self.vec_sensor_tensor, self.actions, self.dt, self.contact_force_scale,
            self.basis_vec0, self.basis_vec1, self.up_axis_idx)

def compute_ant_observations(obs_buf, root_states, targets, potentials,
                             inv_start_rot, dof_pos, dof_vel,
                             dof_limits_lower, dof_limits_upper, dof_vel_scale,
                             sensor_force_torques, actions, dt, contact_force_scale,
                             basis_vec0, basis_vec1, up_axis_idx):
    # type: (Tensor, Tensor, Tensor, Tensor, Tensor, Tensor, Tensor, Tensor, Tensor, float, Tensor, Tensor, float, float, Tensor, Tensor, int) -> Tuple[Tensor, Tensor, Tensor, Tensor, Tensor]

    torso_position = root_states[:, 0:3]
    torso_rotation = root_states[:, 3:7]
    velocity = root_states[:, 7:10]
    ang_velocity = root_states[:, 10:13]

    to_target = targets - torso_position
    to_target[:, 2] = 0.0

    prev_potentials_new = potentials.clone()
    potentials = -torch.norm(to_target, p=2, dim=-1) / dt

    torso_quat, up_proj, heading_proj, up_vec, heading_vec = compute_heading_and_up(
        torso_rotation, inv_start_rot, to_target, basis_vec0, basis_vec1, 2)

    vel_loc, angvel_loc, roll, pitch, yaw, angle_to_target = compute_rot(
        torso_quat, velocity, ang_velocity, targets, torso_position)

    dof_pos_scaled = unscale(dof_pos, dof_limits_lower, dof_limits_upper)

    obs = torch.cat((torso_position[:, up_axis_idx].view(-1, 1), vel_loc, angvel_loc,
                     yaw.unsqueeze(-1), roll.unsqueeze(-1), angle_to_target.unsqueeze(-1),
                     up_proj.unsqueeze(-1), heading_proj.unsqueeze(-1), dof_pos_scaled,
                     dof_vel * dof_vel_scale, sensor_force_torques.view(-1, 24) * contact_force_scale,
                     actions), dim=-1)

    return obs, potentials, prev_potentials_new, up_vec, heading_vec

@torch.jit.script
def compute_reward(
    root_states: torch.Tensor,
    targets: torch.Tensor,
    heading_vec: torch.Tensor,
    actions: torch.Tensor
) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, Dict[str, torch.Tensor]]:
    # Extract relevant state components
    torso_position = root_states[:, 0:3]
    velocity = root_states[:, 7:10]
    ang_velocity = root_states[:, 10:13]

    # Forward direction: horizontal component of direction to target
    to_target = targets - torso_position
    # Zero out the vertical (z) component for forward direction
    forward_dir_2d = to_target[:, 0:2]
    forward_dir_2d_norm = torch.norm(forward_dir_2d, p=2, dim=-1, keepdim=True)
    forward_dir_2d_norm = torch.clamp(forward_dir_2d_norm, min=1e-6)
    forward_dir_2d = forward_dir_2d / forward_dir_2d_norm

    # Forward velocity: projection of velocity onto forward direction (horizontal plane)
    vel_2d = velocity[:, 0:2]
    forward_vel = torch.sum(vel_2d * forward_dir_2d, dim=-1)

    # Uprightness: encourage staying upright (torso height along z-axis)
    torso_height = torso_position[:, 2]
    upright_reward = torso_height - 0.5  # Baseline height for ant is ~0.5

    # Action penalty: discourage large joint torques
    action_penalty = -0.001 * torch.sum(actions * actions, dim=-1)

    # Angular velocity penalty: discourage excessive spinning
    angvel_penalty = -0.01 * torch.sum(ang_velocity * ang_velocity, dim=-1)

    # Total reward: dominated by forward velocity
    reward = forward_vel + 0.5 * upright_reward + action_penalty + angvel_penalty

    reward_components: Dict[str, torch.Tensor] = {
        "forward_vel": forward_vel,
        "upright": 0.5 * upright_reward,
        "action_penalty": action_penalty,
        "angvel_penalty": angvel_penalty,
    }

    return reward, reward_components

    root_states: torch.Tensor,

    actions: torch.Tensor,
    up_vec: torch.Tensor,

    forward_direction = to_target / to_target_norm

    # Project velocity onto forward direction -> forward speed
    forward_speed = torch.sum(velocity * forward_direction, dim=-1)

    # Upright score: z-component of the ant's up vector (1.0 when fully upright)

    # Temperature parameters for reward shaping

    up_temp: float = 20.0
    action_temp: float = 0.001
    joint_vel_temp: float = 0.001

    # Primary reward: forward speed (linear, positive for forward motion)
    speed_reward = forward_speed * speed_temp

    # Upright reward: exponentially scaled so staying upright is strongly rewarded

    joint_vel_penalty = -joint_vel_temp * torch.sum(dof_vel * dof_vel, dim=-1)

@torch.jit.script
def compute_reward(root_states: torch.Tensor, targets: torch.Tensor,
                   dof_vel: torch.Tensor, actions: torch.Tensor,
                   up_axis_idx: int) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, Dict[str, torch.Tensor]]:
    # Extract torso position and velocity from root_states
    torso_position = root_states[:, 0:3]
    velocity = root_states[:, 7:10]

    # Compute direction toward target (horizontal)
    to_target = targets - torso_position
    to_target_norm = torch.norm(to_target, p=2, dim=-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-8
    target_direction = to_target / to_target_norm

    # Forward velocity: projection of velocity onto target direction
    forward_vel = (velocity * target_direction).sum(dim=-1)

    # Height bonus: encourage staying upright (Ant ~0.8m tall)
    height = torso_position[:, up_axis_idx]
    height_reward = (height - 0.8).clamp(min=-1.0)

    # Regularization: penalize large actions and joint velocities
    action_cost = (actions * actions).sum(dim=-1)
    dof_vel_cost = (dof_vel * dof_vel).sum(dim=-1)

    # Temperature parameters for shaping
    temp_forward = 1.0
    temp_height = 2.0
    temp_action = 1.0
    temp_dof_vel = 1.0

    # Shape rewards using soft functions for better gradient signal
    reward_forward = forward_vel * temp_forward
    reward_height = torch.tanh(height_reward * temp_height) * 0.5
    reward_action = -0.05 * action_cost * temp_action
    reward_dof_vel = -0.02 * dof_vel_cost * temp_dof_vel

    # Total reward: strongly incentivize forward speed, moderate height, mild regularization
    reward = reward_forward + reward_height + reward_action + reward_dof_vel

    rewards_dict = {
        "forward": reward_forward,
        "height": reward_height,
        "action": reward_action,
        "dof_vel": reward_dof_vel,
    }

    return reward, rewards_dict

@torch.jit.script
def compute_reward(
    root_states: torch.Tensor,
    targets: torch.Tensor,
    actions: torch.Tensor,
    up_vec: torch.Tensor
) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, Dict[str, torch.Tensor]]:
    # Extract torso position and linear velocity
    torso_position = root_states[:, 0:3]
    velocity = root_states[:, 7:10]

    # Compute heading direction in the xz-plane (toward target)
    to_target = targets - torso_position
    to_target[:, 2] = 0.0
    target_norm = torch.norm(to_target, p=2, dim=-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-6
    heading_dir = to_target / target_norm

    # Forward velocity: project linear velocity onto the heading direction
    forward_vel = torch.sum(velocity * heading_dir, dim=-1)

    # Uprightness: z-component of the torso up-vector (1.0 when fully upright)
    upright = up_vec[:, 2]

    # Action magnitude penalty for encouraging efficient movement
    action_magnitude = torch.sum(actions * actions, dim=-1)

    # Temperature / scaling parameters
    forward_temp = 1.0
    upright_temp = 1.0
    action_temp = 0.05

    # Individual reward components
    forward_reward = forward_vel * forward_temp
    upright_reward = upright * upright_temp
    action_reward = -action_magnitude * action_temp

    # Total reward
    reward = forward_reward + upright_reward + action_reward

    rewards = {
        "forward_vel": forward_reward,
        "upright": upright_reward,
        "action_penalty": action_reward,
    }

    return reward, rewards

@torch.jit.script
def compute_reward(
    root_states: torch.Tensor,
    targets: torch.Tensor,
    actions: torch.Tensor,
    dof_vel: torch.Tensor,
    heading_vec: torch.Tensor,
    dt: float,
) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, Dict[str, torch.Tensor]]:
    # Extract kinematic quantities
    torso_position = root_states[:, 0:3]
    velocity = root_states[:, 7:10]

    # --- Temperature / scaling hyper-parameters ---
    up_temp = 2.0          # temperature for upright shaping
    forward_temp = 10.0    # scaling for forward-velocity reward
    action_coeff = 0.01    # action L2 penalty coefficient
    joint_vel_coeff = 0.001  # joint-velocity L2 penalty coefficient

    # 1) Forward-velocity reward: project world velocity onto the ant's heading
    forward_vel = (velocity * heading_vec).sum(dim=-1)
    forward_reward = forward_temp * forward_vel

    # 2) Progress-toward-target reward (horizontal only)
    to_target = targets - torso_position
    to_target = to_target.clone()
    to_target[:, 2] = 0.0
    to_target_norm = torch.norm(to_target, p=2, dim=-1, keepdim=True).clamp(min=1e-6)
    to_target_dir = to_target / to_target_norm
    target_vel = (velocity * to_target_dir).sum(dim=-1)
    target_reward = target_vel

    # 3) Upright / alive reward: keep torso at a reasonable height
    torso_up = torso_position[:, 2]
    # Penalise heights significantly below 0.75 m (typical standing height)
    deficit = torch.relu(0.75 - torso_up)
    alive_reward = torch.exp(-up_temp * deficit) - 1.0  # in [-1, 0]; 0 when upright

    # 4) Regularisation terms
    action_penalty = action_coeff * (actions ** 2).sum(dim=-1)
    joint_vel_penalty = joint_vel_coeff * (dof_vel ** 2).sum(dim=-1)

    # Total reward
    reward = forward_reward + target_reward + alive_reward - action_penalty - joint_vel_penalty

    components = {
        "forward_reward": forward_reward,
        "target_reward": target_reward,
        "alive_reward": alive_reward,
        "action_penalty": action_penalty,
        "joint_vel_penalty": joint_vel_penalty,
    }

    return reward, components

    target_norm = torch.norm(to_target, p=2, dim=-1, keepdim=True)
    target_norm = torch.clamp(target_norm, min=1e-6)
    target_dir = to_target / target_norm

    # Forward velocity: project velocity onto target direction
    forward_vel = torch.sum(velocity * target_dir, dim=-1)

    # Height reward: keep torso at a reasonable height (~0.8 for ant)
    height = torso_position[:, up_axis_idx]
    height_reward = -torch.abs(height - 0.8)

    # Action penalty: discourage large/jerky movements
    action_penalty = -0.001 * torch.sum(actions * actions, dim=-1)

    # Total reward
    reward = forward_vel + 0.5 * height_reward + action_penalty

    components = {
        "forward_reward": forward_vel,
        "height_reward": height_reward,
        "action_penalty": action_penalty,
    }

    return reward, components

@torch.jit.script
def compute_reward(
    root_states: torch.Tensor,
    targets: torch.Tensor,
    dof_pos: torch.Tensor,
    dof_vel: torch.Tensor,
    up_axis_idx: int,
    actions: torch.Tensor,
) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, Dict[str, torch.Tensor]]:
    # Extract torso position and linear velocity
    torso_position = root_states[:, 0:3]
    velocity = root_states[:, 7:10]
    ang_velocity = root_states[:, 10:13]

    # Compute direction to target (projected onto horizontal plane)
    to_target = targets - torso_position
    to_target[:, 2] = 0.0
    to_target_norm = to_target / (torch.norm(to_target, dim=-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-8)

    # Primary reward: forward velocity along target direction
    forward_vel = (velocity * to_target_norm).sum(dim=-1)
    forward_temp = 1.0
    forward_reward = forward_vel / forward_temp

    # Alive/height bonus: encourage staying upright
    height = torso_position[:, up_axis_idx]
    height_temp = 0.2
    alive_bonus = torch.exp(-height / height_temp)  # higher when close to ground, lower when up

    # Better: reward for maintaining a minimum height
    height_bonus = torch.tanh(height / 0.25) * 0.1

    # Penalty for falling (height too low)
    fall_penalty = torch.relu(0.4 - height) * 5.0

    # Penalty for excessive angular velocity (tumbling)
    ang_vel_penalty = (ang_velocity ** 2).sum(dim=-1) * 0.01

    # Penalty for large joint velocities (wasting energy)
    dof_vel_penalty = (dof_vel ** 2).sum(dim=-1) * 0.001

    # Penalty for large actions (energy cost)
    action_penalty = (actions ** 2).sum(dim=-1) * 0.02

    # Total reward
    reward = forward_reward + height_bonus - fall_penalty - ang_vel_penalty - dof_vel_penalty - action_penalty

    reward_dict = {
        "forward_reward": forward_reward,
        "height_bonus": height_bonus,
        "fall_penalty": fall_penalty,
        "ang_vel_penalty": ang_vel_penalty,
        "dof_vel_penalty": dof_vel_penalty,
        "action_penalty": action_penalty,
    }

    return reward, reward_dict

@torch.jit.script
def compute_reward(
    root_states: torch.Tensor,
    targets: torch.Tensor,
    actions: torch.Tensor,
    up_axis_idx: int,
    dt: float,
) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, Dict[str, torch.Tensor]]:
    torso_position = root_states[:, 0:3]
    velocity = root_states[:, 7:10]
    ang_velocity = root_states[:, 10:13]

    # Direction to target in 2D (ignore z)
    to_target = targets - torso_position
    to_target_2d = torch.stack((to_target[:, 0], to_target[:, 1]), dim=-1)
    to_target_dist = torch.norm(to_target_2d, p=2, dim=-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-6
    to_target_dir_2d = to_target_2d / to_target_dist
    # Extend to 3D with zero z-component for dot product with velocity
    to_target_dir = torch.stack(
        (to_target_dir_2d[:, 0], to_target_dir_2d[:, 1], torch.zeros_like(to_target_dist[:, 0])),
        dim=-1,
    )

    # Forward velocity: how fast the ant moves toward the target
    forward_vel = (velocity * to_target_dir).sum(dim=-1)

    # Temperature parameters
    upright_temp: float = 0.4
    ang_vel_temp: float = 0.3

    # --- Reward components ---

    # 1) Forward velocity reward (primary objective: run as fast as possible)
    forward_vel_reward = forward_vel * 10.0

    # 2) Uprightness reward: keep torso at a reasonable height
    height = torso_position[:, up_axis_idx]
    target_height = 0.8
    upright_reward = torch.exp(-((height - target_height) ** 2) / upright_temp) - 1.0

    # 3) Angular velocity penalty: keep the ant stable
    ang_vel_penalty = -torch.exp(torch.sum(ang_velocity ** 2, dim=-1) / ang_vel_temp) + 1.0

    # 4) Action regularization: discourage excessive joint torques
    action_penalty = -torch.sum(actions ** 2, dim=-1) * 0.01

    # Total reward
    total_reward = forward_vel_reward + upright_reward + ang_vel_penalty + action_penalty

    components: Dict[str, torch.Tensor] = {}
    components["forward_vel"] = forward_vel_reward
    components["upright"] = upright_reward
    components["ang_vel_penalty"] = ang_vel_penalty
    components["action_penalty"] = action_penalty

    return total_reward, components

@torch.jit.script
def compute_reward(
    root_states: torch.Tensor,
    targets: torch.Tensor,
    dof_pos: torch.Tensor,
    dof_vel: torch.Tensor,
    actions: torch.Tensor,
    heading_vec: torch.Tensor,
    up_vec: torch.Tensor,
    vec_sensor_tensor: torch.Tensor,
    dt: float,
    contact_force_scale: float,
    dof_vel_scale: float
) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, Dict[str, torch.Tensor]]:
    # Extract relevant states
    torso_position = root_states[:, 0:3]
    velocity = root_states[:, 7:10]
    ang_velocity = root_states[:, 10:13]

    # --- Forward velocity reward (primary objective) ---
    # Project world velocity onto the ant's heading direction
    forward_vel = (velocity * heading_vec).sum(dim=-1)

    forward_vel_temp = 0.1
    forward_vel_reward = torch.exp(forward_vel * forward_vel_temp)

    # --- Position / target tracking reward (shaping) ---
    to_target = targets - torso_position
    to_target_z = torch.zeros_like(to_target[:, 0:1])
    to_target = torch.cat([to_target[:, 0:1], to_target[:, 1:2], to_target_z], dim=-1)  # zero out z
    target_dist = torch.norm(to_target, p=2, dim=-1)
    pos_temp = 0.01
    pos_reward = -target_dist * pos_temp

    # --- Upright reward (stability) ---
    # Reward for keeping the ant's local up aligned with world up
    # up_vec shape is [num_envs, 3]; world up is [0, 0, 1]
    world_up = torch.tensor([0.0, 0.0, 1.0], device=root_states.device)
    upright_proj = (up_vec * world_up).sum(dim=-1)
    upright_reward = upright_proj * 0.1

    # --- Angular velocity penalty (smoothness / stability) ---
    ang_vel_penalty = -(ang_velocity ** 2).sum(dim=-1) * 0.02

    # --- Joint velocity penalty (avoid jerky movements) ---
    dof_vel_penalty = -(dof_vel ** 2).sum(dim=-1) * 0.001

    # --- Action magnitude penalty (energy efficiency) ---
    action_penalty = -(actions ** 2).sum(dim=-1) * 0.001

    # --- Contact force penalty (avoid excessive forces) ---
    force_magnitude = torch.norm(vec_sensor_tensor.view(-1, 24), p=2, dim=-1) * contact_force_scale
    force_penalty = -force_magnitude * 0.001

    # Total reward
    reward = (
        forward_vel_reward
        + pos_reward
        + upright_reward
        + ang_vel_penalty
        + dof_vel_penalty
        + action_penalty
        + force_penalty
    )

    reward_dict = {
        "forward_vel": forward_vel_reward,
        "position": pos_reward,
        "upright": upright_reward,
        "ang_vel_penalty": ang_vel_penalty,
        "dof_vel_penalty": dof_vel_penalty,
        "action_penalty": action_penalty,
        "force_penalty": force_penalty,
    }

    return reward, reward_dict

def compute_reward(root_states: torch.Tensor, targets: torch.Tensor, actions: torch.Tensor) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, Dict[str, torch.Tensor]]:
    # Extract relevant states
    torso_position = root_states[:, 0:3]
    velocity = root_states[:, 7:10]
    ang_velocity = root_states[:, 10:13]

    # Compute forward direction (projected onto horizontal plane, axis 2 is up)
    to_target = targets - torso_position
    to_target[:, 2] = 0.0

    to_target_norm = torch.norm(to_target, p=2, dim=-1, keepdim=True).clamp(min=1e-6)
    forward_dir = to_target / to_target_norm

    # Forward velocity: dot product of velocity with forward direction
    forward_vel = (velocity * forward_dir).sum(dim=-1)

    # Height of the ant (z-axis is up)
    height = torso_position[:, 2]

    # Reward components
    # Primary reward: forward velocity (encourages fast forward motion)
    forward_reward = forward_vel

    # Fall penalty: if the ant is too low, it's likely fallen over
    fall = (height < 0.3).to(torch.float32)
    fall_penalty = fall * 10.0

    # Action penalty: discourage large joint torques for efficiency
    action_penalty = 0.001 * (actions ** 2).sum(dim=-1)

    # Angular velocity penalty: discourage tumbling/spinning
    ang_vel_penalty = 0.05 * (ang_velocity ** 2).sum(dim=-1)

    # Total reward
    reward = forward_reward - action_penalty - fall_penalty - 0.1 * ang_vel_penalty

    return reward, {
        "forward_vel": forward_reward,
        "action_penalty": action_penalty,
        "fall_penalty": fall_penalty,
        "ang_vel_penalty": ang_vel_penalty * 0.1,
    }

@torch.jit.script
def compute_reward(
    root_states: torch.Tensor,
    targets: torch.Tensor,
    dof_vel: torch.Tensor,
    actions: torch.Tensor,
    up_axis_idx: int,
    dt: float,
) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, Dict[str, torch.Tensor]]:
    # Extract relevant state components
    velocity = root_states[:, 7:10]
    torso_position = root_states[:, 0:3]
    ang_velocity = root_states[:, 10:13]

    # Forward direction: direction toward target, projected onto ground plane
    to_target = targets - torso_position
    to_target[:, up_axis_idx] = 0.0
    to_target_norm = torch.norm(to_target, p=2, dim=-1, keepdim=True).clamp(min=1e-6)
    forward_dir = to_target / to_target_norm

    # Main reward: forward velocity component (drive ant to run forward fast)
    forward_vel = (velocity * forward_dir).sum(dim=-1)
    forward_reward = forward_vel

    # Upright reward: keep the ant's torso elevated so it doesn't flip over
    upright_reward = torso_position[:, up_axis_idx]

    # Penalties to encourage smooth, stable locomotion
    action_penalty = (actions * actions).sum(dim=-1)
    ang_vel_penalty = (ang_velocity * ang_velocity).sum(dim=-1)
    joint_vel_penalty = (dof_vel * dof_vel).sum(dim=-1)

    # Weighted combination: forward speed dominates, with stability shaping
    weight_forward = 10.0
    weight_upright = 1.0
    weight_action = 0.01
    weight_ang_vel = 0.01
    weight_joint_vel = 0.001

    reward = (
        weight_forward * forward_reward
        + weight_upright * upright_reward

@torch.jit.script
def compute_reward(
    root_states: torch.Tensor,
    heading_vec: torch.Tensor,
    up_vec: torch.Tensor,
    dof_pos: torch.Tensor,
    dof_limits_lower: torch.Tensor,
    dof_limits_upper: torch.Tensor,
    actions: torch.Tensor,
) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, Dict[str, torch.Tensor]]:

    velocity = root_states[:, 7:10]

    # Project velocity and heading to ground plane (x-y)

    vel_ground[:, 2] = 0.0
    heading_ground = heading_vec.clone()
    heading_ground[:, 2] = 0.0
    heading_norm = torch.norm(heading_ground, p=2, dim=-1, keepdim=True).clamp(min=1e-6)
    heading_ground = heading_ground / heading_norm

    # Forward speed: dot product of ground velocity with heading direction
    forward_speed = (vel_ground * heading_ground).sum(dim=-1)

    # Upright reward: z-component of up vector (1.0 when perfectly upright)
    upright = up_vec[:, 2]

    # Action cost: penalize large control inputs for energy efficiency
    action_cost = (actions ** 2).sum(dim=-1)

    # Joint limits penalty: discourage joints from exceeding their range
    below = torch.clamp(dof_limits_lower - dof_pos, min=0.0)
    above = torch.clamp(dof_pos - dof_limits_upper, min=0.0)
    joint_penalty = (below ** 2).sum(dim=-1) + (above ** 2).sum(dim=-1)

    # Temperate (scoring) parameters for each component
    speed_temp = 1.0
    upright_temp = 5.0
    action_temp = 0.01
    joint_temp = 1.0

    reward_speed = speed_temp * forward_speed
    reward_upright = upright_temp * upright
    reward_action = -action_temp * action_cost
    reward_joint = -joint_temp * joint_penalty

    total_reward = reward_speed + reward_upright + reward_action + reward_joint

    return total_reward, {
        "forward_speed": reward_speed,
        "upright": reward_upright,
        "action_cost": reward_action,
        "joint_penalty": reward_joint,

def compute_reward(
    root_states: torch.Tensor,
    targets: torch.Tensor,
    up_vec: torch.Tensor,
    actions: torch.Tensor,
    dof_vel: torch.Tensor
) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, Dict[str, torch.Tensor]]:
    temp_forward_vel: float = 5.0
    temp_action: float = 10.0
    temp_joint_vel: float = 50.0

    torso_position = root_states[:, 0:3]
    velocity = root_states[:, 7:10]
    torso_height = torso_position[:, 2]

    # Forward direction: project target direction onto xz plane
    to_target = targets - torso_position
    to_target[:, 2] = 0.0
    to_target_norm = torch.norm(to_target, p=2, dim=-1, keepdim=True)
    to_target_norm = torch.clamp(to_target_norm, min=1e-6)
    forward_dir = to_target / to_target_norm

    # Primary reward: forward velocity component (higher is better)
    forward_vel = torch.sum(velocity * forward_dir, dim=-1)
    forward_vel_reward = torch.tanh(forward_vel / temp_forward_vel) * temp_forward_vel

    # Bonus: reward for actually being in contact / moving (not airborne)
    # Use up_vec z-component: ant should be roughly upright
    up_z = up_vec[:, 2]
    upright_reward = torch.clamp(up_z, max=1.0)

    # Height reward: keep ant at reasonable height (penalize falling)
    height_reward = torch.clamp(torso_height, min=0.0, max=0.7) / 0.7

    # Survival/alive bonus
    alive_reward = torch.where(torso_height > 0.05, torch.ones_like(torso_height), torch.zeros_like(torso_height))

    # Penalties
    action_penalty = -torch.exp(-torch.sum(actions ** 2, dim=-1) / temp_action) * 0.1
    joint_vel_penalty = -torch.exp(-torch.sum(dof_vel ** 2, dim=-1) / temp_joint_vel) * 0.05

    total_reward = (
        forward_vel_reward +
        0.3 * upright_reward +
        0.2 * height_reward +
        0.1 * alive_reward +
        action_penalty +
        joint_vel_penalty
    )

    reward_components = {
        "forward_vel": forward_vel_reward,
        "upright": upright_reward,
        "height": height_reward,
        "alive": alive_reward,
        "action_penalty": action_penalty,
        "joint_vel_penalty": joint_vel_penalty,
    }

    return total_reward, reward_components

@torch.jit.script
def compute_reward(
    root_states: torch.Tensor,
    up_vec: torch.Tensor,
    heading_vec: torch.Tensor,
    actions: torch.Tensor,
    dof_vel: torch.Tensor,
) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, Dict[str, torch.Tensor]]:
    # Extract linear velocity from root states (indices 7:10)
    velocity = root_states[:, 7:10]
    
    # Forward velocity: project velocity onto the ant's heading direction
    forward_vel = torch.sum(velocity * heading_vec, dim=-1)
    
    # Uprightness: z-component of up vector (1.0 when perfectly upright)
    upright = up_vec[:, 2]
    
    # Height: z-position of torso (avoid dragging on ground)
    torso_height = root_states[:, 2]
    
    # Angular velocity (indices 10:13) for stability penalty
    ang_vel = root_states[:, 10:13]
    ang_vel_penalty = torch.sum(ang_vel * ang_vel, dim=-1)
    
    # Action penalty for efficiency
    action_penalty = torch.sum(actions * actions, dim=-1)
    
    # Temperature / weight parameters
    forward_weight = 1.0
    upright_temperature = 0.5
    height_temperature = 0.1
    action_weight = 0.01
    angvel_weight = 0.01
    
    # Reward: forward velocity (primary goal - run as fast as possible)
    reward_forward = forward_weight * forward_vel
    
    # Reward: uprightness (keep ant standing, use exp transformation)
    upright_error = (1.0 - upright) * (1.0 - upright)
    reward_upright = torch.exp(-upright_temperature * upright_error)
    
    # Reward: maintain reasonable torso height (avoid dragging)
    reward_height = torch.exp(-height_temperature * (torso_height - 0.75) * (torso_height - 0.75)) - 1.0
    
    # Penalty: large actions (encourage smooth, efficient motion)
    reward_action = -action_weight * action_penalty
    
    # Penalty: high angular velocity (encourage stability)
    reward_angvel = -angvel_weight * ang_vel_penalty
    
    total_reward = reward_forward + reward_upright + reward_height + reward_action + reward_angvel
    
    reward_dict = {
        "forward": reward_forward,
        "upright": reward_upright,
        "height": reward_height,
        "action": reward_action,
        "angvel": reward_angvel,
    }
    
    return total_reward, reward_dict
